name: Metro Tasmania adult student concession fare
summary: Concession bus fares for full-time students aged 19 and over at any university, TasTAFE or the Tasmanian College of English.
who: Full-time students aged 19 or older enrolled at any university, TasTAFE or the Tasmanian College of English
how: Full-time adult students may apply through Building Tasmania for a Special Circumstances Student Greencard.
catches: Fares are currently free for everyone until 30 June 2027; this concession matters after that.
Adult concession applies from the start of the year in which the cardholder turns 19.

evidence.quote: Adult concession applies from the start of the year in which the cardholder turns 19
Full time adult students may be issued a Special Circumstances Student Greencard by Building Tasmania
